data.name: Make the Application Work
data.mission: Bring prepared auction data into the application, make search and AI work, keep visitor information private, and give Monabid staff a review screen.
boundaries: P1 receives prepared source snapshots and does not investigate external providers.
P2 owns general auction search; B3 owns how the buyer assistant uses it.
P3 owns anonymous profiles and privacy, not Buyer or Seller business behavior.
P4 owns the OpenAI-compatible connection and validation; B2 and S1 own their domain instructions.
P5 reads domain APIs and never reads Buyer or Seller tables directly.
dependencies: Project owner: prepared fixtures, representative Bright Data decision, selected OpenAI-compatible provider, deployment path, and branded UI starter.
Buyer and Seller teams: minimum typed contracts, domain prompts, and dashboard-facing APIs.
data.map:
prepared fixtures → P1 consistent auction data → P2 search
P3 private visitor profile → Buyer / Seller
P4 real AI + test fixtures → B2 buyer understanding / S1 seller intake
Buyer/Seller APIs → P5 staff dashboard

buyer.name: Help Buyers Find an Item
buyer.mission: Help buyers speak in Hebrew or English, turn a vague need into accurate criteria, receive explained results, investigate source-backed evidence, and optionally ask Monabid for manual help after receiving value.
boundaries: B1 owns conversation presentation; B2 owns understanding and revising criteria.
B3 uses P2 search but never reimplements it.
B4 owns result lists, item details, evidence navigation, and the post-value help action.
Contact is optional and requested only after useful results or a useful no-result explanation.
The reduced project has no saved alerts, scheduled matching, notifications, or email delivery.
dependencies: P1/P2: consistent auction data, sources, and search.
P3/P4: anonymous profiles, contact/consent, and AI connection.
Project owner: prepared fixtures, BidSpirit examples, and approved UI components.
buyer.map:
B1 conversation → B2 understands and preserves criteria → B3 uses P2 search
B3 explained matches or unmet demand → B4 results + details + evidence → optional P3 help request

seller.name: Help Sellers Understand and Submit an Item
seller.mission: Help sellers describe an item, add photographs, see comparable sales and a safe valuation, choose an auction house, and create a Monabid enquiry.
boundaries: S1 owns dialogue and seller confirmation.
S2 owns media, not AI conclusions.
S4 calculates range and confidence from selected evidence.
S5 recommends houses and creates the final lead.
dependencies: P1 auction houses and historical results; P3 private profile/contact fields; P4 AI connection.
Project owner: local-file deployment path, six-comparable seller fixtures, exchange-rate fixtures, and active-house metadata.
seller.map:
S1 intake ↔ S2 private evidence → S3 comparable ranking → S4 range + confidence
confirmed item + valuation → S5 house recommendation + internal lead
